paper_reference: TelePreview: A User-Friendly Teleoperation System with Virtual Arm Assistance for Enhanced Effectiveness
description: Preview gate for the SEW + functional hybrid xArm7 trajectory. It emulates TelePreview's preview-only then align/execute state transition using Gazebo/FK safety checks instead of physical AR overlay.

virtual_preview.representation: Gazebo digital twin aligned to the xArm7 link_base frame
virtual_preview.calibration_source: Existing robot_world/base transform and D455 Gazebo scene; AprilTag calibration is the physical-world equivalent in the paper.

decision_policy.APPROVE: All hard and soft gates pass.
decision_policy.APPROVE_WITH_WARNINGS: Hard safety gates pass, but soft smoothness or functional-quality gates recommend retiming or review.
decision_policy.BLOCK: At least one hard safety gate fails; keep the motion in preview mode and do not execute.
